sourceTitle: How to make French Toast Roll Up
sourceText:
How to make French Toast Roll Up
By: Rahul Upadhyay
Published: Thursday, September 7, 2017 - 1:30am

Ingredients




Whole Wheat Bread: 8 Slices
Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam: 4 tbsp
Eggs: 2
Skimmed milk: 2 tbsp
Butter: 1 tbsp
Serve any fruit: 1/4 cup
Cinnamon powder: 1/2 tsp

Preparation

1 Mix castor sugar and cinnamon powder in a bowl and keep aside. 2 Remove the crust from the bread slices. Roll them gently using a rolling pin. 3 Apply Kissan Mixed Fruit jam on the slices and roll them tightly. 4 Whisk egg and milk in a bowl. 5 Heat 1 tbsp butter in a pan. 6 Dip the bread rolls in an egg and milk mixture and place them in the pan. Cook from all sides until browned. 7 Immediately coat with the sugar cinnamon mixture.

About

French Toast Roll up Recipe is Easy to make Healthy Recipe for Kids. It is Protein Enrich Snack with Tangy Taste of Kissan Fruit Jam.
Watch and learn how to make an easy French Toast Roll Up by Neha Mathur. French Toast is a perfect breakfast recipe to start your day with. Don’t forget to add some Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam and serve it to your kids.
